newsitem.title: USA: APTV to tap into PanAmSat PAS-5 satellite.
newsitem.headline: APTV to tap into PanAmSat PAS-5 satellite.

text.p: PanAmSat Corp said Wednesday the Associated Press Television (APTV) will tap into the company's PAS-5 Atlantic Ocean Region satellite to expand its news gathering and news distribution operations within and between the Americas and Europe.

APTV, the video arm of the Associated Press news cooperative, will use a total of 18 Megahertz on PAS-5's C-band Americas beam, which provides coverage of Latin America, the United States and Canada, as well as direct access to Europe, the company said.
